fields.title: Design: invoiced card keeps "Lead technician" and "Service advisor" labels
fields.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on, so that a work order can have a different Labor and Parts representative.
  • Have a first work order with one approved labor line, one part, "Sales Representative - Labor" set to one of them and "Sales Representative - Parts" set to the other, and invoice it.
  • Have a second work order, open and not invoiced.
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "card-17-n1-invoiced.png" (board 1.17) and "card-02-n1-rest.png" (board 1.2) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the first work order in that browser window.
fields.custom_steps:
1. Without hovering, read the labels of the four fields on the card and compare them with the picture of board 1.17.
  2. Hover over the four fields.
  3. Open the second work order and compare its Lead Technician, Service Advisor and Sales Representative labels with the picture of board 1.2.
fields.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The labels read "Lead technician" and "Service advisor" (small second word, as on an invoiced card today).
  • Then come "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts", with capital letters.
  • Each name sits below its label as plain text, as in the picture.

Step 2:

  • Nothing changes: no box, no arrow, no + and no remove x.

Step 3:

  • On the open work order the labels read "Lead Technician", "Service Advisor" and "Sales Representative", as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative), story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R17: “Once the work order is invoiced or paid, or when it is opened from its history, each field is plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. A work order with both fields shows both labels with their names. On the read-only card only the Sales Representative fields read as in S1-R2 and S2-R5; Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's read-only labels.”
  • S1-R2: “The field is the same field as Lead Technician and Service Advisor: the label "Sales Representative" sits inside it on the first line and the name on the second, in the same text style, size, weight and left edge.”

From: Chris Ward's answers, question sheet of 19 Oct 2026, Google Sheet 17Ry1BtRTPEkecBP5TlgAE0T93Ai1TQewdJ7B7WpWDBQ, tab "Questions for Chris", rows 6-43 (answered 19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026

  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.

  4. Export the Expanded PDF and read the Adjustments cells of the same two rows.
fields.custom_expected:
Expected Result

  • The work order's invoice shows one Labor row under sales rep A.
  • Its Adjustments reads ($30.00) (600 ÷ 1,000 × 50).
